description: Run Claude Code over ACP on your GitHub Copilot subscription, set up from the plugin settings with a GitHub sign-in. Copilot's GPT, Gemini and Grok models sit next to Claude in the model picker. In Accept Edits, Bash runs in Claude Code's sandbox, as with bb's own Claude Code provider, and /compact works. In plan mode Claude waits for your go-ahead, even in Full Access. Each thread's Copilot credits show above the prompt, a usage page has the token dashboard, and your premium-request quota shows in the provider usage panel. Requires Node.js, Claude Code and a GitHub Copilot subscription.
